annotations.title: Run a read-only tool by name

description: Runs one read-only tool by its name with its arguments, exactly as calling it directly does: the same sign-in, scopes and limits. Use it for a tool search_tools or enable_toolset named that your client does not list. A tool that changes something runs through call_write_tool.

arguments.description: The tool's arguments, as its input schema asks.

name.description: The tool's name, as search_tools gives it.
